meaning_en: The right to enter a place or join a group.
example_en: Admission to the museum is free.

meaning_en: Burning brightly; on fire.
example_en: The old house was completely alight after the fire started.

meaning_en: A large room where people watch performances.
example_en: The school auditorium can hold 500 students.

meaning_en: To state something officially or publicly.
example_en: You must declare all goods at customs.

meaning_en: To get off a horse, bicycle, or other vehicle.
example_en: Please dismount your bicycle before entering the park.

meaning_en: To show something publicly.
example_en: The museum will display ancient artifacts.

meaning_en: To interrupt someone or something.
example_en: Please do not disturb the sleeping baby.

meaning_en: Do not leave your bags alone.
meaning_fa: کیف‌های خود را بدون مراقب رها نکنید
example_en: The airport sign said, 'Do not leave bags unattended'.

meaning_en: The act of going in or a place to go in.
example_en: No entry after 10 PM.

meaning_en: To give food to a person or animal.
example_en: Please feed the cat before you leave.

meaning_en: easily broken or damaged.
example_en: Be careful, the glass is fragile.

meaning_en: Official advice about dangers to health.
example_en: Cigarettes have a health warning on them.

meaning_en: Happening now, not yet finished.
meaning_fa: در حال انجام، در دست اقدام
example_en: The building work is still in progress.

meaning_en: To hurt yourself or someone else.
example_en: Be careful not to injure yourself.

meaning_en: To stay away from something.
example_en: Please keep off the grass.

meaning_en: To stay on the right or left side.
example_en: In the UK, drivers must keep left.

meaning_en: To bend or rest against something.
example_en: Don't lean on the wet paint.

meaning_en: Rubbish left in a public place.
example_en: Please don't drop litter here.

meaning_en: Be careful of the step.
example_en: The sign said, "Mind the step."

meaning_en: Be careful not to hit your head.
example_en: Mind your head, the ceiling is low.

meaning_en: Not important or serious.
example_en: It was a minor problem, easily fixed.

meaning_en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
example_en: He rides his motorbike to work.

meaning_en: You cannot go into this place.
example_en: The sign says "No entry" here.

meaning_en: There is no way out from this place.
example_en: We are stuck; there is no exit.

meaning_en: You cannot park your car here.
example_en: Look, there's a "No parking" sign.

meaning_en: No rooms are available in this hotel.
example_en: The hotel sign said "No vacancies."

meaning_en: A written or printed announcement.
example_en: There's a notice on the wall.

meaning_en: Not working correctly.
example_en: The lift is out of order.

meaning_en: A punishment for breaking a rule or law.
example_en: There is a penalty for late payment.

meaning_en: An official document allowing you to do something.
example_en: You need a permit to park here.

meaning_en: The people who work for an organization.
example_en: All personnel must wear ID badges.

meaning_en: Not allowed; forbidden.
example_en: Smoking is strictly prohibited here.

meaning_en: To officially accuse someone of a crime.
example_en: The police decided to prosecute him.

meaning_en: stand in a line waiting for something
example_en: Please queue here for tickets.

meaning_en: To make something smaller or less.
example_en: We need to reduce our waste.

meaning_en: To stop yourself from doing something.
example_en: Please refrain from smoking in this area.

meaning_en: to spend time in prison as punishment
example_en: He had to serve five years in prison.

meaning_en: Complete absence of sound.
example_en: Please keep silence in the library.

meaning_en: All tickets or items are gone.
example_en: The concert tickets are sold out.

meaning_en: Someone who goes onto private land without permission.
example_en: A sign warned trespassers to stay off the property.

meaning_en: Not with another person or people.
example_en: Children under 12 must be accompanied.

meaning_en: Not allowed by official permission.
example_en: Do not enter this area; it is unauthorised.

meaning_en: a machine that transports people or goods
example_en: A car is a type of vehicle.

meaning_en: A statement telling you about a possible danger.
example_en: The sign gave a warning about falling rocks.
